title: Arduino and ESP32 sketch tasks graded by compile
goal: Arduino and ESP32 sketch tasks graded by compile
acceptance: Sketch tasks compiled with arduino-cli and a pinned ESP32 core (owner decision 2026-11-24) plus static checks; no hardware
Compiling and non-compiling fixtures prove the grader deterministically
privacy: Neutral invented cases and fixtures only; no consumer data, private reports or credentials in Git.
validation: Failing pack test first; fixture for each acceptance item; npm test; npm run check:index; CI
escalation: No knowledge of any consumer; a consumer-specific need goes to that consumer's backlog
Material scope or effort growth goes to the owner before adoption

effort.basis: Implemented 2026-11-25 in this PR: four sketch tasks (Uno and ESP32, regression and holdout), examples/embedded-v1/grade.mjs (static checks, include guard, arduino-cli compile against pinned cores, missing-toolchain errors) and test/embedded-grader.test.ts (stand-in CLI everywhere; real compiles where installed). Estimated 2026-11-24 in the domain-packs plan (owner request) at observed agent speed for one-PR pack steps. Not a measurement.
